question: Which statement best describes Main idea?
options: Character encoding tells the browser how to read bytes as text. UTF-8 supports the characters used by most languages. It is like agreeing on the alphabet before reading a note. Declare it early in the head so punctuation and international text display correctly. For example, declare the page language so speech tools can select suitable pronunciation.

A description can summarize a page for search and sharing previews. Search engines may choose other text, so the description is not a guaranteed snippet. It is like a short back-cover summary. Make it accurate and specific to the page, and do not promise content the page does not provide. For example, write a description that accurately summarizes the current page content.

`<title>` names the page in the browser tab, history, and bookmarks. A useful title tells people which page they opened. It is like writing a clear title on a folder. Give each important page a distinct title and avoid stuffing it with repeated keywords. For example, give the page a distinct title that matches the visible main heading.

The viewport setting tells a mobile browser how to size the page layout. Without it, a phone may render a desktop-sized page and shrink it. It is like choosing the right paper size before laying out a document. Include the standard responsive viewport metadata and test at narrow widths. For example, set a viewport so a phone uses its actual device width.
